about: Gate 72 block M (TC-R181) run alone (CT_G72_ONLY=M) at 320x568 (the job's), kunal761 (375x761, insets 51/31) and 844x390 sideways (CT_G72_M_GEOS): both drills (mistakes, brilliant), never scrolling - #root.scrollTop asserted 0 - every button of the drill's bottom area (Hint, Show move, Reset, Prev, Next; Analyse after a solve) is the element under its own centre, asking and after a solve, each state's denominator on its own line. NOT COVERED: the other four of THE DRILL SEVEN here (the suite runs block M at all seven), a real phone's home-indicator area, the drill's top card.

breaks.name: bottom-pushed-under-the-bar
breaks.why: the drill's bottom area starts 70px below the card instead of 8 (#550's control): at 320x568 Prev and Next come to rest under the tab bar, the job's defect

breaks.name: row-drops-under-the-bar
breaks.why: upright, the drill's five-button row is drawn 56px lower than its box (position relative), so its buttons sit under the tab bar while the layout above is unchanged

breaks.name: row-drops-off-the-sideways-rail
breaks.why: sideways only, the drill's button row is drawn 80px lower, past the bottom of the screen
